title: Matrix Calculation in the General Linear Case
body_html:
Matrix Calculation in the General Linear Case

For the split dual pair \((\operatorname{GL}(n),\operatorname{GL}(n'))\), \(n\le n'\), identify \[ W=\operatorname{Mat}_{n,n'}\oplus\operatorname{Mat}_{n,n'}. \] On the diagonal test subspace \[ A=\{(a\;0,\;b\;0):a=\operatorname{diag}(a_1,\ldots,a_n),\ b=\operatorname{diag}(b_1,\ldots,b_n)\}, \] the moment maps become \[ M(a,b)=ab,\qquad M'(a,b)= \begin{pmatrix} ab&0\\ 0&0 \end{pmatrix}. \]
proof_html: The formulas follow from the standard matrix realization of the type \(A\) dual pair, where the two moment maps are \(xy^t\) and \(y^tx\). Restricting to the diagonal test subspace makes the invariant polynomials visible as elementary symmetric polynomials in the products \(a_ib_i\).
